<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>明月高悬</title>
<style>
:root{--blue:#2d44d8;--navy:#1a2780;--ink:#34449c;--sky:#8fb0e8;--pale:#eef2fc;--line:#cbd6f3;--yel:#fbe98a}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{font-family:"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans SC",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f6f8fe,#e3eafa 55%,#cfdbf4) fixed;line-height:1.6;min-height:100vh}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit;border-radius:0}
svg.cam{width:1em;height:1em;color:var(--blue);cursor:pointer;flex:none}
svg.bloom{animation:bl .9s}
@keyframes bl{40%{transform:scale(1.4) rotate(50deg)}100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(0)}}
.fall{position:fixed;top:-40px;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;color:var(--sky);opacity:.4;animation:fa linear infinite}
@keyframes fa{0%{transform:translate(0,-5vh) rotate(0)}50%{transform:translate(40px,55vh) rotate(180deg)}100%{transform:translate(-20px,112vh) rotate(360deg)}}
.shell{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1360px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:210px minmax(0,1fr) 250px;gap:16px;align-items:start}
.pn{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.78);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(45,68,216,.09)}
.top{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:2px 6px}
.top .homeb{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);font-size:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer}
.logo{font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC",serif;letter-spacing:.35em;font-size:22px;color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.logo svg{font-size:20px}
.logo small{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;opacity:.7;font-family:"PingFang SC",sans-serif}
/* sidebar */
.side{padding:20px 12px;position:sticky;top:14px}
.prof{text-align:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.av{width:92px;height:92px;margin:0 auto 8px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--line);background:var(--pale);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;font-size:46px}
.av img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.prof b{display:block;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:500}
.prof small{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:12px;opacity:.7}
#nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
#nav button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:0;background:none;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:14px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;color:var(--ink)}
#nav svg{font-size:20px;--cf:#fff;color:var(--sky)}
#nav b{font-weight:500;font-size:14px;display:block;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:.1em}
#nav i{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-style:normal;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;opacity:.55;display:block}
#nav button:hover{background:var(--pale)}
#nav button.on{background:var(--pale);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line)}
#nav button.on svg{color:var(--blue);--cf:#c9d6ff}
.side .foot{text-align:center;font-size:11px;opacity:.6;margin-top:12px;letter-spacing:.15em;font-family:Georgia,serif}
/* decor */
.deco{position:absolute;font-size:120px;opacity:.16;animation:sp 70s linear infinite;pointer-events:auto}
.d1{right:-34px;top:-34px}.d2{left:-40px;bottom:-40px;font-size:90px;animation-direction:reverse}
@keyframes sp{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.pc{position:absolute;right:-10px;top:-10px;font-size:46px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;padding:4px}
.orn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;color:var(--sky);margin:6px 0}
.orn::before,.orn::after{content:"";width:60px;border-top:1.5px dotted var(--sky)}
.orn svg{font-size:16px}
/* main */
main{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;min-width:0}
.sec{padding:20px 22px}
.hd{text-align:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.hd .en{font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC",serif;font-size:30px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--blue);text-indent:.3em}
.hd .cn{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.4em;opacity:.75}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:26px;padding:26px;align-items:center}
.pol{position:relative;width:270px;padding:16px;background:#fff;border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(45,68,216,.15),inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--line)}
.pf{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:16px;background:var(--pale);overflow:hidden}
.pf img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.df{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.ps{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:16px;background:var(--pale)}
.ps img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.ps.banner{height:84px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);margin-bottom:12px}
.ps.banner.has{height:150px;border-style:solid}
.ps.sq{aspect-ratio:4/3}
.pe{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;opacity:.55;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.2em;pointer-events:none}
.pe svg{font-size:26px}
.pb{position:absolute;right:8px;bottom:8px;display:flex;gap:4px;z-index:3}
.pb button,.cm{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;padding:0 10px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
.cm{position:absolute;right:8px;bottom:8px;z-index:3;font-size:11px;padding:0 9px;opacity:0;transition:.2s}
.card:hover .cm{opacity:1}
@media(hover:none){.cm{opacity:.85}}
.ptag{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-14px;transform:translateX(-50%);min-width:120px;max-width:86%;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;border-radius:20px;font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC",serif;font-size:12px;padding:2px 16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(45,68,216,.18);letter-spacing:.12em;outline:none;cursor:text;z-index:2}
.ptag:empty::before{content:"写点状态…";opacity:.4}
.ptag:focus{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--blue)}
.pol .pb{bottom:-13px;right:18px}
.ht{text-align:center}
.ht .sm{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.25em;opacity:.65}
.ht h2{font-family:"Songti SC","Noto Serif SC",Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(44px,7vw,76px);letter-spacing:.2em;text-indent:.2em;color:var(--blue);cursor:pointer;user-select:none;line-height:1.3;margin:6px 0}
.ht h2:hover{letter-spacing:.28em}
.ht h2{transition:.4s}
.ht .sm2{letter-spacing:.5em;text-indent:.5em}
.bub{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--pale);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:14px}
.bub .ci{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:24px;flex:none}
.bub small{display:block;font-size:11px;opacity:.6}
/* tools */
.tools{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.tools input{flex:1;min-width:130px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;padding:5px 16px;border-radius:999px;outline:none}
.tools input:focus{border-color:var(--blue)}
.btn{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--blue);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 16px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.08em}
.btn.o{background:#fff;color:var(--blue)}
.btn:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(45,68,216,.3)}
.chips{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.chip{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:0 12px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
.chip.on{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue)}
/* board */
.board{position:relative;min-height:50vh;border-radius:18px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);background:rgba(238,242,252,.6) radial-gradient(rgba(45,68,216,.22) 1px,transparent 1.6px) 0 0/24px 24px;overflow:hidden}
.card{position:absolute;width:150px;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;user-select:none;font-size:14px;z-index:1;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;animation:fl 7s ease-in-out infinite;transition:opacity .25s,box-shadow .2s}
@media(min-width:560px){.card{width:180px}}
@keyframes fl{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
.card:hover{z-index:3}
.card.drag{animation:none;transform:scale(1.05);z-index:9;cursor:grabbing;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(26,39,128,.3)!important}
.cb{padding:10px 13px}
.card small{display:block;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;opacity:.75}
.card h3{font-size:17px;line-height:1.3;margin:2px 0 4px;word-break:break-all;font-weight:500}
.card p{font-size:12px;opacity:.85;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;white-space:pre-line}
.v0{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.v1{background:#fff;color:var(--blue);border:1.5px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(45,68,216,.12)}
.v2{background:#dfe8ff;color:var(--navy)}
.cc{position:absolute;right:6px;top:6px;font-size:22px;opacity:.55}
.v0 .cc{color:#fff}
.ph{position:relative;line-height:0}
.ph img{width:100%;height:105px;object-fit:cover;filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.05)}
.ph::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(45,68,216,.28)}
.bgfl{position:absolute;left:50%;top:24px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(340px,92%);height:auto;aspect-ratio:1;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;opacity:.55}
.lc{position:absolute;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;z-index:0;color:var(--blue)}
.lc svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.dim{opacity:.12;pointer-events:none}
.item{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:10px 14px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer}
.item:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(45,68,216,.15)}
.item.dim{display:none}
.item img{width:64px;height:64px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;filter:grayscale(1);flex:none}
.item small{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:12px;opacity:.7;display:block}
.item p{font-size:13px;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical}
.empty{padding:30px;text-align:center;letter-spacing:.2em;opacity:.7}
.empty svg{font-size:40px;display:block;margin:0 auto 6px}
.note{font-size:12px;opacity:.65;margin-top:8px;text-align:center}
.bk{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
/* widgets */
.rt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.wg{padding:18px}
.wg h4{font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC",serif;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.15em;font-size:18px;color:var(--sky);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline}
.wg h4 span{font-size:11px;color:var(--ink);opacity:.6}
.moon{width:96px;height:96px;display:block;margin:10px auto 6px;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 10px rgba(26,39,128,.3))}
.wg .c{text-align:center;font-size:13px}
.big{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:34px;color:var(--blue);line-height:1}
.big small{font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);letter-spacing:.1em;margin-left:6px}
.td{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.td input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 12px;outline:none}
.td button{width:32px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}
.tl{margin-top:8px;font-size:13px}
.tl div{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px dotted var(--line)}
.tl .t{flex:1;word-break:break-all}.tl .dn .t{text-decoration:line-through;opacity:.5}
.tl x{cursor:pointer;opacity:.5}
/* modal */
.mask{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(26,39,128,.45);z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px}
.win{background:#f9fbff;border:2px solid var(--blue);border-radius:20px;overflow:auto;width:100%;max-width:560px;max-height:92vh;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(26,39,128,.35)}
.bar{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 16px;letter-spacing:.12em;position:sticky;top:0}
.box{padding:14px 18px 18px}
.win label{display:block;font-size:13px;margin-top:10px}
.win input[type=text],.win input[type=date],.win textarea{width:100%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:6px 11px;background:#fff;outline:none}
.win textarea{height:200px;resize:vertical}
.pre{max-width:100%;max-height:200px;margin-top:8px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;justify-content:flex-end}
.tcard{width:180px;height:290px;position:relative;transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform 1.3s;margin:0 auto}
.tcard.flip{transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.f{position:absolute;inset:0;backface-visibility:hidden;border:3px solid #fff;border-radius:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center}
.front{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-size:60px}
.back{background:#fff;color:var(--blue);transform:rotateY(180deg)}
.back .in{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.back.rv .in{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.back em{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-style:normal;letter-spacing:.2em}
.back .mo{font-size:54px;line-height:1}
.back b{font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-indent:.2em}
.mask .row.c{justify-content:center;margin-top:22px}
/* splash V3: photographic moon, editorial midnight sky */
#splash{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 18%,rgba(72,91,146,.23),transparent 42%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 16% 82%,rgba(68,82,133,.22),transparent 48%),#11182b;color:#f7f8fd;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;transition:opacity 1s;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
#splash:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%,#fff9 0 1px,transparent 2px),radial-gradient(circle at 75% 58%,#fff8 0 1px,transparent 2px),radial-gradient(circle at 55% 12%,#fff7 0 1px,transparent 2px);background-size:170px 190px,230px 270px,310px 240px;opacity:.42}
#splash canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.62}
#splash>*:not(canvas){position:relative}
#splash .sc{position:absolute;color:#dbe4f8;opacity:.055;font-size:260px;animation:sp 90s linear infinite}
#splash h2{font-family:Georgia,'Noto Serif SC',serif;font-size:clamp(26px,6.4vw,42px);letter-spacing:.23em;margin:0 0 15px;font-weight:400;text-indent:.23em;text-shadow:0 2px 24px #0b1426}
#splash p{font-size:clamp(12px,3vw,15px);letter-spacing:.15em;line-height:1.9;color:#c5cfe4;padding:0 22px;opacity:1}
.ld{position:relative;width:220px;height:220px;margin:45px 0 17px;transition:opacity .5s;filter:drop-shadow(0 16px 28px #070b19aa)}
.ld .ring{position:absolute;inset:0;width:220px;height:220px;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.mn{position:absolute;left:25px;top:25px;width:170px;height:170px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #ffffff29,0 0 35px #d9e6ff20;overflow:hidden}
.mn img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%}
.pct{position:absolute;right:-11px;bottom:8px;background:#f9fafc;color:#24365c;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:500;padding:5px 13px;transform:none;border:1px solid #d8e1ee;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 4px 20px #070c1c88;letter-spacing:.03em}
.ldt{letter-spacing:.32em;color:#c4d0e6;font-size:12px;font-weight:400;transition:opacity .5s}
#enter{display:none;margin-top:30px;background:#f7f8fc;border:1px solid #e8ecf5;color:#233455;padding:12px 38px;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.25em;cursor:pointer;animation:fi 1.2s;border-radius:2px}
#enter:hover{background:#dce7fa;color:#15244a}
@keyframes fi{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@media(max-height:650px){.ld{margin:18px 0 8px;transform:scale(.78)}#splash h2{font-size:26px}}
/* egg */
#egg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:40;background:rgba(228,237,251,.95);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer}
#egg .r{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:40px;height:40px;margin:-20px;border:2px solid var(--blue);border-radius:50%;opacity:0;animation:rp 4.5s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes rp{0%{transform:scale(.3);opacity:.7}100%{transform:scale(14);opacity:0}}
#egg .t{position:relative;text-align:center;color:var(--navy);font-size:24px;letter-spacing:.35em;text-indent:.35em;line-height:2.4;opacity:0;filter:url(#rip)}
.cr{position:fixed;width:20px;height:20px;margin:-10px;border:2px solid var(--blue);border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;z-index:30;opacity:.8;animation:cr .9s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes cr{to{transform:scale(7);opacity:0}}
.pg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.pg .ps.sq{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:14px}
.pg .pe span{display:none}
.pg .pb{right:5px;bottom:5px}
.pg .pb button{font-size:11px;padding:0 7px}
.bkp{grid-column:1/-1;padding:16px 20px;text-align:center}
.bkp .t{font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.25em;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:8px}
.bkp small{display:block;font-size:12px;opacity:.65;margin-top:8px}

/* zones v4 */
body:not(.home) .rt{display:none}
@media(min-width:961px){body:not(.home) .shell{grid-template-columns:210px minmax(0,1fr)}}
.hd{position:relative}
.hb{position:absolute;left:0;top:2px;padding:2px 12px;font-size:13px}
.zs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 14px;justify-content:center;padding:6px 0 4px}
.zb{width:96px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;color:var(--blue);font-family:inherit}
.zb svg{width:82px;height:82px;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1);overflow:visible;--cf:#fff}
.zb:hover svg{transform:rotate(60deg) scale(1.1)}
.zb b{font-weight:500;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink)}
.zb i{font-style:normal;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;opacity:.55;color:var(--ink)}
.mini{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--blue);cursor:pointer;margin-left:4px;line-height:1}
.pg.one{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.card p{-webkit-line-clamp:var(--lc,3)}
.v3{background:#fff3bf;color:#6b5a1a}
.win select{width:100%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:6px 11px;background:#fff}
.vs{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px}.vr{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px dotted var(--line)}
.vr .btn{padding:0 12px;font-size:12px}
/* char */
.cg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:14px}
.pcard{cursor:pointer;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;transition:.25s}
.pcard:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(45,68,216,.18)}
.pi{position:relative;aspect-ratio:3/4;background:var(--pale);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.pi img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.pi svg.big{font-size:64px;opacity:.35}
.pcard:hover .cm{opacity:1}
.pn2{padding:8px 12px 10px}.pn2 b{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--blue);letter-spacing:.1em}.pn2 small{font-size:12px;opacity:.7}
/* world */
.wl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;gap:16px}
.wlist{max-height:70vh;overflow:auto;border-right:1.5px dashed var(--line);padding-right:10px}
.wc{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--sky);margin:10px 0 4px}
.wi{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:0;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
.wi:hover{background:var(--pale)}.wi.on,.wi.on:hover{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.wd h3{font-size:24px;color:var(--blue);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em}
.wb{white-space:pre-wrap;margin:10px 0;line-height:1.9}
.lk{color:var(--blue);border-bottom:1.5px dotted var(--blue);cursor:pointer}.lk.no{opacity:.55;border-bottom-style:dashed}
.bl{font-size:13px;margin-top:12px}.bl button{background:var(--pale);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:0 10px;margin:2px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--blue)}
.tag{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;background:var(--pale);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:0 9px;margin-left:6px;color:var(--blue)}
@media(max-width:700px){.wl{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wlist{max-height:170px;border:0}}
/* lore */
.fd{margin-bottom:10px}
.fd summary{cursor:pointer;font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC",serif;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--blue);padding:6px 2px;list-style:none}
.fd summary small{opacity:.6;margin-left:6px}
/* fav */
.fv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px}
.fc{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
.fc:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(45,68,216,.15)}
.fc img{width:100%;height:120px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.fc h3{font-weight:500;font-size:17px;color:var(--blue)}.fc small{font-size:11px;opacity:.7;font-family:Georgia,serif}
.fc a{color:var(--blue);font-size:13px}.stars{color:#e8b923;letter-spacing:2px}
.fc p{font-size:13px;opacity:.85;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical}
/* timeline */
.tv{position:relative;padding:10px 0}
.tv::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;border-left:2px dotted var(--sky)}
.te{position:relative;width:50%;padding:0 30px 22px 0;text-align:right;cursor:pointer}
.te.r{margin-left:50%;padding:0 0 22px 30px;text-align:left}
.te .nd{position:absolute;right:-13px;top:4px;font-size:26px;background:var(--pale);border-radius:50%}
.te.r .nd{left:-13px;right:auto}
.te small{font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC",serif;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--sky);font-size:14px}
.te h3{font-weight:500;color:var(--blue);font-size:18px}
.te p{font-size:13px;opacity:.85;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;white-space:pre-line}
.te:hover h3{letter-spacing:.1em}
@media(max-width:700px){.tv::before{left:13px}.te,.te.r{width:100%;margin-left:0;padding:0 0 18px 44px;text-align:left}.te .nd,.te.r .nd{left:0;right:auto}}
/* tarot multi */
.tr3{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start}
.tw2{text-align:center;color:#fff}.pl{margin-top:8px;letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:13px}
.tcard.s{width:104px;height:172px}.tcard.s .front{font-size:36px}.tcard.s .back b{font-size:16px}.tcard.s .back em{font-size:12px}
/* floating todo */
#tdw{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:24px;width:250px;z-index:15;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(45,68,216,.25);display:none;overflow:hidden}
body.home #tdw{display:block}
#tdw .th{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;padding:5px 8px 5px 14px;font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.15em;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;user-select:none}
#tdw .th button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);border:0;color:#fff;border-radius:50%;width:24px;height:24px;cursor:pointer}
#tdw .tb{padding:10px 12px 12px;max-height:50vh;overflow:auto}
#tdw .bub2{display:none;position:relative;width:54px;height:54px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px;color:#fff;cursor:grab;touch-action:none;user-select:none}
#tdw .bub2 i{position:absolute;right:3px;top:3px;min-width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--yel);color:var(--navy);font-size:11px;font-style:normal;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 4px}
#tdw.min{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);border:0}
#tdw.min .th,#tdw.min .tb{display:none}
#tdw.min .bub2{display:flex}
@media(max-width:560px){#tdw{width:228px}}

/* v5 zones */
.mask.top{z-index:40}
.zb .ic{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);border:1.5px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(45,68,216,.12)}
.zb .ic svg{width:58px;height:58px;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1)}
.zb:hover .ic svg{transform:rotate(36deg) scale(1.15)}
.zb.sn:hover .ic svg{transform:rotate(60deg) scale(1.15)}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.tab{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 18px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);font-size:15px}
.tab.on{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue)}.tab.add{border-style:dashed;color:var(--blue)}
.sel{border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;padding:4px 10px;outline:none;max-width:100%}
.pgh{font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC",serif;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--blue);margin:16px 0 8px;font-size:16px}.pgh small{opacity:.6;margin-left:6px}
.wgr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:12px}
.wcard{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.wcard:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(45,68,216,.16)}
.wcard img{width:100%;height:90px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.wcard b{color:var(--blue);font-weight:500;font-size:16px}
.wcard p{font-size:13px;opacity:.85;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;margin:2px 0;white-space:pre-line}
.wcard small{font-size:11px;opacity:.65}
.ep2{opacity:.45;font-size:13px;padding:4px 2px}
.wdt h3{font-size:26px;color:var(--blue);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:6px}
.wsum{font-family:Georgia,"Songti SC",serif;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--sky);margin:16px 0 6px}
.wb{white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.9}
.lb{background:var(--pale);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:0 12px;margin:2px 4px 2px 0;cursor:pointer;color:var(--blue)}
.chhead{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;margin:4px 0 14px}
.chav{width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--line);background:var(--pale);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;flex:none}
.chav img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.chintro{display:block;margin:4px 0 5px;padding:3px 8px 3px 0;max-width:460px;min-width:130px;min-height:28px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;outline:none;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);cursor:text}
.chintro:empty:before{content:"点击填写角色简介…";color:var(--sky)}
.chintro:focus{border-bottom-color:var(--blue);background:rgba(238,242,252,.55)}
.chn{font-family:"Songti SC",Georgia,serif;font-size:30px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--blue)}.chhead small{opacity:.65}
.chl{display:grid;gap:10px}
.chc{display:flex;gap:12px;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:12px 14px;cursor:pointer}
.chc:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(45,68,216,.15)}
.chc img{width:70px;height:70px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;flex:none}
.chc b{color:var(--blue);font-weight:500}
.chc p{font-size:13px;margin:3px 0;white-space:pre-line;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical}
.chc u{text-decoration:none;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--sky);margin-right:8px}
.fm{columns:2 180px;column-gap:14px}
.fm .fc{break-inside:avoid;margin-bottom:14px;display:block}
.item u{text-decoration:none;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--sky);margin-right:6px}
.tq{color:#fff;text-align:center;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto 16px;letter-spacing:.1em}
/* doc overlays */
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:25;background:#f4f7fe;display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:var(--ink)}
.ovb{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;flex-wrap:wrap}
.grow{flex:1}
.dti{flex:1;min-width:140px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 14px;font-size:16px;outline:none}
.tb2{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px 14px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tb2 button{border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:2px 11px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--blue)}
.tb2 button:hover{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.edm{flex:1;display:flex;min-height:0}
.tree{width:200px;overflow:auto;padding:12px;border-right:1.5px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);font-size:13px}
.tree a{display:block;cursor:pointer;padding:3px 0;color:var(--ink)}.tree a.l2{padding-left:14px;opacity:.85}.tree a:hover{color:var(--blue)}
.eaw,.rdw{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:20px 14px}
.ea,.doc{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:30px 34px;min-height:70%;font-family:"Songti SC","Noto Serif SC",serif;line-height:2;font-size:17px;outline:none;color:#222}
.ea h1,.doc h1{font-size:28px;text-align:center;margin:.8em 0 .5em;color:var(--navy)}
.ea h2,.doc h2{font-size:21px;margin:.8em 0 .3em;color:var(--blue)}
.ea blockquote,.doc blockquote{margin:.8em 1.2em;padding:2px 14px;border-left:4px solid var(--sky);color:#556;background:var(--pale)}
.ea p,.doc p{margin:.35em 0}
.ea ul,.ea ol,.doc ul,.doc ol{margin:.5em 0 .5em 1.6em}
.dm{text-align:center;font-size:12px;opacity:.65;margin-bottom:1em;font-family:sans-serif}
.ovf{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:8px 14px;border-top:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:13px}
.ovb .btn,.ovf .btn{padding:3px 14px}
@media(max-width:700px){.tree{display:none}.ea,.doc{padding:20px 18px}}

/* weather */
.wxr{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:10px}
.wxi{font-size:30px;color:var(--blue);width:40px;text-align:center;line-height:1}
.wxr b{font-size:16px;color:var(--blue);display:block;line-height:1.2;font-weight:500}
.wxr small{font-size:11px;opacity:.65}
.wxb{margin-top:12px;background:var(--pale);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px;position:relative;line-height:1.7}
.wxb::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:18px;top:-7px;width:11px;height:11px;background:var(--pale);border-left:1.5px solid var(--line);border-top:1.5px solid var(--line);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.wxc{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.wxc button{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;padding:0 10px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--blue)}
.wxc button.on{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue)}

/* music player */
#mp{position:fixed;left:18px;bottom:24px;z-index:16;color:var(--ink);user-select:none;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px)}
#mp .mpb,#mp .mpr,#mp .mpl{display:none}
#mp.ball .mpb{display:flex}#mp.bar .mpr{display:flex}#mp.big .mpl{display:block}
.vk{position:relative;border-radius:50%;background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle,#2a3a9c 0 1.5px,#141f6c 1.5px 3.5px);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(20,33,111,.35);flex:none;overflow:hidden}
.vk::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 20deg,rgba(255,255,255,.24),transparent 18%,transparent 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.24) 68%,transparent 85%)}
.vk::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:33%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#fbe98a 0 14%,#fff 16% 52%,var(--blue) 55%);border:1.5px solid #fff}
.spin{animation:vs 5s linear infinite;animation-play-state:paused}
#mp.playing .spin{animation-play-state:running}
@keyframes vs{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.mpb{width:56px;height:56px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);border:1.5px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(45,68,216,.28);cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
.mpb .vk{width:42px;height:42px}
.mpr{width:320px;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px);height:56px;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:0 10px 0 7px;border-radius:28px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border:1.5px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(45,68,216,.25);cursor:grab;touch-action:none;position:relative}
.mpr .vk{width:42px;height:42px;margin-right:3px}
.mpt{flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ib{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--pale);color:var(--blue);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:none}
.ib svg{width:16px;height:16px}.ib.pl{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}.ib:hover{box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(45,68,216,.3)}
.mpp{position:absolute;left:26px;right:26px;bottom:3px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--pale);overflow:hidden}
.mpp i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--blue)}
.mpl{width:290px;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(45,68,216,.3);overflow:hidden}
.mph{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;padding:6px 8px 6px 16px;font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.2em;cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
.mpbd{padding:14px 16px 16px;text-align:center}
.mpl .vk{width:176px;height:176px;margin:4px auto 10px;cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
.mptt{font-size:15px;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:6px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.mpl input[type=range]{width:100%;accent-color:var(--blue)}
.mpd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;opacity:.7}
.mpc2{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;margin:8px 0}
.mpc2 .ib.pl{width:42px;height:42px}.mpc2 .ib.pl svg{width:20px;height:20px}
.mpmode{font-size:11px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:0 10px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--blue);height:26px}
.mpvr{font-size:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.mpls{max-height:120px;overflow:auto;text-align:left;font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:6px}
.mpi{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer}
.mpi:hover{background:var(--pale)}.mpi.on{background:var(--blue);color:#fff}
.mpi span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.mpi b{opacity:.6;font-weight:400}
.mpa{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px}.mpa .btn{padding:2px 12px;font-size:12px}
.mpm{font-size:12px;color:#c0392b;min-height:16px;margin-top:4px}
/* responsive */
@media(max-width:960px){
 .shell{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding:10px 10px 90px}
 .side{position:static;padding:0;background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;overflow:visible}
 .prof,.side .foot{display:none}
 #nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;flex-direction:row;overflow-x:auto;gap:4px;padding:8px 8px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:rgba(246,248,254,.95);border-top:1.5px solid var(--line);z-index:6}
 #nav button{flex:none;padding:5px 12px}
 #nav i{display:none}
 .hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;justify-items:center;padding:22px 16px}
 .pol{width:230px}
 .rt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .rt .wg:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}
 .sec{padding:16px 14px}
}

/* V4 atmospheric opening: misty moonlight, floral haze, restrained starfield */
#splash{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 75%,rgba(169,182,212,.34),transparent 65%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 17%,rgba(97,111,151,.27),transparent 48%),linear-gradient(155deg,#101322 0%,#1b2137 46%,#3a435e 100%)}
#splash:before{opacity:.27;z-index:1}
#splash canvas{opacity:.33;z-index:1}
#splash .sc{opacity:.035;z-index:2;filter:blur(3px)}
#splash .mist-layer{position:absolute;inset:-22%;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;opacity:.9;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 24% at 20% 35%,rgba(233,236,247,.17),transparent 85%),radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 22% at 78% 65%,rgba(224,232,247,.21),transparent 88%),radial-gradient(ellipse 45% 28% at 44% 90%,rgba(231,232,243,.24),transparent 85%);filter:blur(28px);animation:mistDrift 19s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}
#splash .mist-layer.second{opacity:.53;filter:blur(43px);animation-duration:27s;animation-direction:alternate-reverse;transform:scale(1.12)}
#splash>*:not(canvas):not(.mist-layer){z-index:3}
#splash h2{color:#f6f6fa;text-shadow:0 2px 26px rgba(9,12,29,.55);font-weight:400}
#splash p{color:#d9dbe8;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(8,11,26,.65)}
#splash .ld{filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 36px rgba(6,9,26,.48))}
#splash .mn{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(246,247,255,.3),0 0 45px rgba(216,223,244,.13)}
@keyframes mistDrift{0%{translate:-4% 2%;scale:1}50%{translate:3% -2%;scale:1.06}100%{translate:7% 3%;scale:1.02}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#splash .mist-layer{animation:none}}

/* V5: 明亮雾蓝色星空，参考站内浅蓝雾感与四芒星 */
#splash{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 48% at 52% 38%,rgba(204,220,251,.83),transparent 92%),radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 65% at 15% 78%,rgba(153,181,233,.83),transparent 88%),radial-gradient(ellipse 85% 55% at 88% 8%,rgba(102,142,214,.64),transparent 88%),linear-gradient(158deg,#425d9e 0%,#789bd4 36%,#b5c9ed 62%,#8baada 100%);color:#fff}
#splash:before{opacity:.14}
#splash .mist-layer{opacity:1;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 25% at 18% 22%,rgba(251,252,255,.81),transparent 84%),radial-gradient(ellipse 88% 27% at 77% 56%,rgba(241,246,255,.77),transparent 84%),radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 33% at 42% 90%,rgba(245,249,255,.7),transparent 85%);filter:blur(39px);animation-duration:22s}
#splash .mist-layer.second{opacity:.83;filter:blur(56px);background:radial-gradient(ellipse 66% 23% at 64% 12%,rgba(245,249,255,.8),transparent 88%),radial-gradient(ellipse 72% 25% at 12% 69%,rgba(224,235,255,.86),transparent 90%),radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 27% at 80% 98%,rgba(238,244,255,.86),transparent 90%)}
#splash canvas{opacity:.98;z-index:2}
#splash h2{text-shadow:0 2px 22px rgba(54,80,145,.52)}
#splash p,#splash .ldt{color:#f8fbff;text-shadow:0 1px 12px rgba(51,79,150,.4)}
#splash .sc{opacity:.065;color:#f4f8ff}
#splash .mn{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #ffffff6a,0 0 36px #edf4ff8a}
#splash #enter{box-shadow:0 6px 28px rgba(58,91,155,.17)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="splash">
  <canvas id="stars"></canvas>
  <div class="mist-layer" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="mist-layer second" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <svg class="cam sc" style="left:-60px;top:-60px" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><use href="#cam"/></svg>
  <svg class="cam sc" style="right:-70px;bottom:-70px;animation-direction:reverse" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><use href="#cam"/></svg>
  <h2>世界缝隙之间</h2>
  <p>我们还有无数时间交汇的未来</p>
  <div class="ld" id="ld">
    <svg class="ring" viewBox="0 0 190 190" width="220" height="220"><circle cx="95" cy="95" r="88" fill="none" stroke="rgba(204,218,246,.18)" stroke-width="5"/><circle id="arc" cx="95" cy="95" r="88" fill="none" stroke="#dce8ff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="553" stroke-dashoffset="553"/></svg>
    <div class="mn"><img src="data:image/png;base64,
